messages.ui.connectionSecurityHelp: Select an option to enable that verification or connection permission.
messages.ui.behaviorOptionsHelp: Select an option to enable that behavior.
messages.ui.verifySslHelp: Verify the server certificate for HTTPS connections. Keep this on for normal HTTPS connections.
messages.ui.allowPrivateHelp: Allow connections to localhost, internal LAN, and Docker private addresses. Enable only when required.
messages.ui.allowHttpHelp: Allow unencrypted http:// connections. Enable only when required for a trusted local connection.
messages.ui.streamingHelp: Receive the answer in parts. Enable this only when the configured provider supports streaming.
messages.core.name: RAG Core
messages.core.description: Connects verified documents to Standard or Custom RAG and manages LLM answers independently.
messages.core.settings.title: RAG retrieval
messages.core.settings.help: RAG Core is always available. Configure the retrieval and answer providers used by OpenConcept.
messages.ui.title: RAG retrieval and answer generation
messages.ui.providerUnconfigured: No retrieval provider is configured. Select OpenConcept Standard RAG or Custom RAG.
messages.ui.providerConfigured: {provider} is configured as the retrieval provider.
messages.ui.providerRequired: Select OpenConcept Standard RAG or Custom RAG before saving.
messages.ui.postgresqlRequired: OpenConcept Standard RAG requires PostgreSQL to be the canonical database. Prepare and connect PostgreSQL before selecting Standard RAG.
messages.ui.pgvectorRequired: The canonical database is PostgreSQL, but pgvector is not installed. Standard RAG cannot be saved until the vector extension is available.
messages.ui.standardDetails: Standard RAG connection and advanced settings
messages.ui.disableRetrievalHelp: Continue using the common AI search route without the RAG evidence pipeline.
messages.ui.sharedAiHelp: Use the saved AI provider shown above. Changes there also apply to RAG answer generation.
messages.ui.separateAiHelp: Use this only when RAG answers must use a different endpoint or model from the common AI connection.
messages.ui.legacyProviderHelp: This saved route is retained only so you can migrate it. Select a supported answer route before saving.
messages.ui.apiKeyConfigured: ＊＊＊＊ (configured; enter a new value only to replace it)
messages.ui.saved: Saved. A new generation is built when retrieval settings changed.
messages.ui.connectionOkSaveRequired: Connection succeeded. Save these values before using them.
messages.ui.savedValuesHelp: Saved values are shown below. Select Save after making changes. Connection testing does not save changes.
messages.ui.effectiveFallbackHelp: No active RAG index is serving questions. AI Search continues through the saved common AI connection.
messages.ui.effectiveRagHelp: Questions use active index generation {generation}, then the saved answer setting shown below.
messages.ui.retrievalMissingHelp: Select and configure a retrieval engine before RAG search can be used.
messages.ui.standardUnavailable: Standard RAG unavailable on the current database
messages.ui.standardPgvectorMissing: Standard RAG unavailable: pgvector is not installed
messages.ui.retrievalEngineHelp: Finds evidence in workspace documents. Standard and Custom connection values are retained separately; changing the selection creates a new index generation.
messages.ui.standardChoiceHelp: OpenConcept manages chunking, embeddings, and search. PostgreSQL with pgvector is required.
messages.ui.customChoiceHelp: Uses the built-in HTTP connection for the next Custom RAG generation. No plugin switch is required; search changes after that generation is activated.
messages.ui.standardBaseUrlHelp: OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint used by Standard RAG.
messages.ui.embeddingModelHelp: Changing the embedding model requires a complete new index generation.
messages.ui.chunkTargetHelp: Approximate text size of each searchable unit. Smaller values improve precision but create more chunks.
messages.ui.rrfHelp: Controls how vector and keyword rankings are merged. Keep 60 unless you are tuning retrieval quality.
messages.ui.customBaseUrlHelp: Root URL of a service implementing OpenConcept RAG API v1. This is a retrieval API, not an LLM endpoint.
messages.ui.indexNamespaceHelp: Leave empty when the external service should create and return an index ID.
messages.ui.answerGenerationHelp: Turns verified evidence into a readable answer. Changes in this section do not rebuild the index.
messages.ui.answerInstructionsHelp: These settings shape the answer after evidence is verified. They never rebuild the search index.
messages.ui.evidenceOnlyHelp: Do not call an LLM. Show only the verified evidence returned by retrieval.
messages.ui.secretEnvHelp: Enter the environment-variable name, never the secret value.
messages.ui.noUnsavedChangesHelp: The summary above reflects the configuration currently in use.
messages.ui.rebuildRequiredHelp: Saving starts a new generation. The current active index remains available until the new one is activated.
messages.ui.noRebuildRequiredHelp: Only answer generation changes; the existing search index remains active.
messages.ui.flowHelp: This diagram shows the route currently selected in the form. Unsaved changes do not yet affect users' AI Search. Search settings take effect after you save them and activate a new index generation.
messages.ui.flowDisplayNotice: Regardless of which RAG or AI API you select, results are displayed in OpenConcept's “AI Search” panel. You will not be redirected to an external service.
messages.ui.flowScopeHelp: This flow covers regular AI Search across the entire workspace. “Answer using only this page,” page summaries, and page editing actions use the shared AI connection.
messages.ui.flowRuntimeRagHelp: The active {provider} index is currently in use.
messages.ui.flowQuestionHelp: A user submits a question from “AI Search” in the left menu (Ctrl/⌘+K).
messages.ui.flowQuestionImpact: Changing the search or answer provider does not change where users enter questions.
messages.ui.flowQuestionDestination: The OpenConcept “AI Search” panel opened from the left menu. Submitted questions remain in the conversation.
messages.ui.flowRetrievalStandardHelp: OpenConcept searches its managed PostgreSQL/pgvector index. The Embedding API shown here vectorizes document chunks and the question.
messages.ui.flowRetrievalCustomHelp: The OpenConcept server sends the question and access scope to the configured OpenConcept RAG API v1 and receives evidence candidates from that service's index.
messages.ui.flowRetrievalDisabledHelp: RAG is bypassed and the saved shared AI Search route is used. The RAG answer settings below are not used on this route.
messages.ui.flowRetrievalDestination: Retrieved candidates return to OpenConcept and proceed to evidence verification. Nothing is displayed directly at this stage.
messages.ui.flowRetrievalDisabledDestination: The browser stays in OpenConcept while processing continues through the shared AI Search route.
messages.ui.flowEvidenceHelp: For every candidate, OpenConcept rechecks current viewing permissions, document revision, and source identity, then removes inaccessible or stale evidence.
messages.ui.flowEvidenceDestination: Only verified evidence is passed to answer generation and later appears under “Sources” in the answer.
messages.ui.flowEvidenceSkippedHelp: RAG-specific evidence verification is not performed. The shared AI Search route uses its own permission-aware search.
messages.ui.flowEvidenceSkippedDestination: This stage is not shown on screen and is skipped when RAG is disabled.
messages.ui.flowAnswerSharedHelp: The server sends the question and verified evidence to the shared AI API configured under “AI and voice providers,” then receives a natural-language answer.
messages.ui.flowAnswerSharedImpact: Changes to the shared AI connection affect both regular AI Search and RAG answers. The index does not need to be rebuilt.
messages.ui.flowAnswerSeparateHelp: The server sends the question and verified evidence to the dedicated OpenAI-compatible API for RAG and receives an answer. The shared AI and voice connection is unchanged.
messages.ui.flowAnswerEvidenceOnlyHelp: No request is sent to an LLM. Verified evidence is converted to Evidence JSON, and no natural-language answer is generated.
messages.ui.flowAnswerEvidenceOnlyDestination: Evidence JSON proceeds directly to result display within OpenConcept. Nothing is sent to an external API, and no screen transition occurs.
messages.ui.flowAnswerFallbackValue: Shared AI connection (RAG answer settings not used)
messages.ui.flowAnswerFallbackHelp: The answer is generated through the saved shared AI Search route rather than the RAG answer settings.
messages.ui.flowAnswerFallbackImpact: Until RAG is enabled, changing the RAG answer settings does not affect the answers users receive.
messages.ui.flowAnswerDestination: The selected AI API only generates the answer; its response returns to OpenConcept. The connected service's screen does not open.
messages.ui.flowAnswerFallbackDestination: Responses from the shared AI also return to OpenConcept's “AI Search” panel.
messages.ui.flowFallbackOutput: Shared AI Search answer and sources
messages.ui.flowOutputHelp: The generated answer and accessible sources are displayed in OpenConcept's “AI Search” panel. The display location remains the same even when an external API is selected.
messages.ui.flowOutputEvidenceOnlyHelp: Evidence JSON is displayed in the answer area of OpenConcept's “AI Search,” with sources listed underneath.
messages.ui.flowOutputFallbackHelp: The shared AI Search answer and sources are displayed in the same OpenConcept “AI Search” panel.
messages.ui.flowOutputDestination: OpenConcept's “AI Search” panel. Selecting a source beneath the answer opens the corresponding OpenConcept page in the main area.
messages.ui.impactReindex: Saving builds a new index generation. The current route remains in use until you activate it.
messages.ui.flowCustomReindexImpact: Saving sends snapshots of registered documents to the configured destination and builds an external index. The current route remains in use until you activate the new generation.
messages.ui.impactAnswerOnly: Changing this does not rebuild the index
messages.ui.impactRagDisabled: Saving switches to shared AI Search. No index is built.
messages.ui.ragBypassHelp: The request bypasses the RAG evidence pipeline.
messages.ui.diagnosticsHelp: Problems are linked to the setting that must be corrected.
messages.ui.diagnosticsReadyHelp: No contradictory or incomplete settings were detected.
messages.ui.issueBaseUrlHelp: Enter the root URL of the service used at this step.
messages.ui.issueBaseUrlInvalidHelp: Use http:// or https:// without credentials or a # fragment.
messages.ui.issueModelHelp: Enter the exact model identifier exposed by this API.
messages.ui.issueHttpHelp: Enable HTTP only for a trusted local connection, or use HTTPS.
messages.ui.issuePrivateHelp: Allow private-network access for localhost, LAN, or Docker host addresses.
messages.ui.issueDatabase: Standard RAG cannot run on the current database
messages.ui.issueDatabaseHelp: Open the database settings and make PostgreSQL with pgvector the canonical database, or select Custom RAG.
messages.ui.issuePgvectorMissing: pgvector is not installed in the canonical PostgreSQL database
messages.ui.issuePgvectorMissingHelp: Install pgvector for this PostgreSQL server, enable the vector extension, then reload this page. You can use Custom RAG without pgvector in the canonical database.
messages.ui.issueCustomRagHelp: Enter a valid OpenConcept RAG API v1 root URL.
messages.ui.issueRagDisabledHelp: AI Search will not use the RAG evidence pipeline. Select Standard RAG or Custom RAG to enable it.
messages.ui.issueSharedAuthenticationHelp: Save an API key in the common AI connection, provide its environment variable, or select no authentication for a trusted local API.
messages.ui.issueDirectAuthenticationHelp: Enter an API key or the environment-variable name that contains it.
messages.ui.issueCustomAuthenticationHelp: Use localhost or a literal private-network address, and explicitly allow private-network access.
messages.ui.issueLegacyProvider: The saved legacy answer adapter has been retired
messages.ui.issueLegacyProviderHelp: Select the common AI connection or a separate OpenAI-compatible API, then save to migrate this setting.
messages.ui.issueEvidenceOnly: No LLM will generate an answer
messages.ui.issueEvidenceOnlyHelp: Search results remain available as evidence data, but users will not receive a natural-language answer.
messages.ui.issueIndex: No active search index is available
messages.ui.issueIndexHelp: Build the new generation, then activate it from Index status and maintenance.
messages.ui.issueIndexFailedHelp: Open Index status and maintenance to inspect the failed generation ({code}).
messages.ui.retrievalBlockedHelp: Fix the retrieval settings before the RAG evidence pipeline can run.
messages.ui.answerBlockedHelp: Fix the retrieval step before this answer route can run.
messages.ui.outputBlockedHelp: Resolve the highlighted configuration problem before this route can be used.
messages.ui.saveBlockedHelp: Resolve the highlighted configuration problems before saving.
messages.ui.defaultDraft: Recommended defaults are selected but not saved
messages.ui.defaultDraftHelp: Review the highlighted checks, then save to activate this route.
messages.ui.operationsHelp: Inspect index generations, process queued synchronization jobs, or retry one document.
messages.ui.savedRebuildStarted: Saved. A new index generation is now building; activate it after it becomes ready.
messages.ui.savedNoRebuild: Saved. The current search index remains active because retrieval settings did not change.
messages.ui.generationChanged: The active index generation was updated.
messages.ui.invalidServerResponse: The server returned an invalid RAG response. Your selections remain on this screen; reload to verify the saved state.
messages.ui.settingsNotPersisted: The saved settings could not be verified. Your selections remain on this screen.
messages.ui.embeddingNotConfigured: The Embedding Base URL is not configured.
messages.ui.embeddingAuthenticationFailed: Authentication failed. Confirm that the API key configured in OpenConcept matches the Embedding server.
messages.ui.embeddingEndpointNotFound: The /embeddings endpoint was not found. Confirm the Base URL and API version path.
messages.ui.embeddingTimeout: The Embedding server did not respond before the timeout.
messages.ui.embeddingModelUnavailable: The configured embedding model is not loaded or was rejected by the server.
messages.ui.embeddingServiceUnavailable: The Embedding server is starting, overloaded, or temporarily unavailable.
messages.ui.embeddingRequestRejected: The Embedding server rejected the probe request.
messages.ui.embeddingInvalidResponse: The server responded, but its embedding response format is invalid.
messages.ui.embeddingDimensionMismatch: The returned vector dimensions do not match the configured index dimensions.
messages.ui.embeddingTlsFailed: TLS certificate verification or the secure connection failed.
messages.ui.embeddingHttpNotAllowed: The endpoint uses HTTP, but HTTP access is not enabled.
messages.ui.embeddingPrivateNetworkNotAllowed: The endpoint is on a private network, but private-network access is not enabled.
messages.ui.embeddingUrlInvalid: The Embedding Base URL is invalid.
messages.ui.embeddingDnsFailed: The Embedding server host name could not be resolved.
messages.ui.embeddingConnectionRefused: The host refused the connection. Confirm that the Embedding service is running and listening on this port.
messages.ui.embeddingUnreachable: The Embedding server could not be reached.
messages.ui.embeddingUnavailable: The Standard RAG embedding service is unavailable.
messages.ui.embeddingRetryHelp: The settings were saved. Correct the server-side problem, then retry the check and rebuild.
messages.ui.embeddingServerAdminHelp: OpenConcept reports and retries this failure, but a server administrator must start or correct the Embedding service.
messages.ui.embeddingApiKeyConfigured: Configured ({source}); enter a value only to replace it.
messages.ui.embeddingApiKeyOptional: Optional for unauthenticated local services. The environment variable above remains the fallback.
messages.ui.clearStoredEmbeddingKey: Remove the API key stored in OpenConcept
messages.ui.savedWaitingForEmbedding: Saved. Index rebuilding is waiting for the Embedding service; the common AI route remains available.
messages.ui.stillWaitingForEmbedding: The Embedding service is still unavailable. No index jobs were started.
messages.ui.embeddingRecoveredRebuildStarted: Embedding is available. A new RAG index generation is now building.
